answers.workaround: There's workarounds with the current render pipeline but the new pipeline appears to have the potential to simplify a lot of that work.  For example, implementing terrain involves splitting it into chunks for culling, LODing, etc...  Splitting everything into meshlets makes terrain just another object and simplifies a lot.  The roadmap for 4.1 is also to do a lot of 3D optimizations, this is a potential optimization.
